name: Browser
description: A real web page on your canvas, one per window: localhost in a keystroke, phone, tablet and desktop sizes, bookmarks, DevTools. ⌘- or Ctrl-click opens a link in a new window.

api.name: open
api.description: Goes to a page: an address (example.com, localhost:3000, https://…) or words to search for. Answers once it has loaded: { url, title, loading, back, forward, error }.

api.name: state
api.description: Where the page is now: { url, title, loading, back, forward, error }.

api.name: back
api.description: Goes back a page; answers where it is once loaded.

api.name: forward
api.description: Goes forward a page; answers where it is once loaded.

api.name: reload
api.description: Loads the page again; answers where it is once loaded.

api.name: waitForLoad
api.description: Waits for a page that's loading to finish (at most 30 s); answers where it is.

api.name: text
api.description: The page's visible text (or an element's, by selector), at most max characters (100000): { text, truncated, url, title }.

api.name: html
api.description: The page's HTML (or an element's, by selector), at most max characters: { html, truncated }.

api.name: elements
api.description: What can be clicked or typed in, numbered: [{ id, tag, role, type, text, name, placeholder, href, disabled, inView }], at most 500. click and type take an id from here (list again after the page changes).

api.name: click
api.description: Clicks an element: by id (from elements), a CSS selector, or the text it shows. Answers once the page settles: { clicked, url, title, loading, … }.

text.description: What the button or link says

api.name: type
api.description: Types into a field (by id or selector): value replaces what's there unless clear is false; submit presses Enter (and sends its form). Answers where the page is.

api.name: scroll
api.description: Scrolls the page: by pixels (by, default 600; negative goes up), to top or bottom, or to an element (selector). Answers { y, height }.

api.name: run
api.description: Runs JavaScript in the page (its DOM, none of its own scripts): an expression, or statements with return; awaited. Answers what it returns, as JSON.

api.name: screenshot
api.description: A picture of the page as it's drawn: a PNG file's bytes.

api.name: watch
api.description: Where the page goes, as it goes: { type: 'state', … } first, then the page's navigate, title, loading, fail and crash events.

settings.title: Home page
settings.description: What a new Browser opens: anything the address bar takes. Empty: it shows your bookmarks.

settings.title: Device
settings.description: The size a new Browser shows pages at. Responsive fills the window.

settings.title: Bookmarks bar
settings.description: Your bookmarks under the address bar, when you have some.

settings.title: Search engine
settings.description: Where words typed in the address bar go.

settings.title: Custom search URL
settings.description: The address of a search, with %s where the words go.
